name: Jorim
title: Ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy
summary: Jorim is a person mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus in the Gospel of Luke. He was the son of Matthat and the father of Eliezer. He is part of the long lineage connecting King David with Jesus Christ.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus
keyEvents.description: Jorim is listed as one of Jesus' ancestors in the genealogy in the Gospel of Luke, as the son of Matthat and the father of Eliezer.

keyEvents.title: Part of the lineage from David to Jesus
keyEvents.description: Jorim is part of the long lineage that goes from King David through the line of Nathan down to Joseph, Jesus' earthly father.

keyEvents.title: Placed in the line of Nathan
keyEvents.description: Unlike Matthew's genealogy which follows the line of Solomon, Luke places Jorim in the line of Nathan from David, showing God's faithfulness through generations.

keyEvents.title: The connection between generations
keyEvents.description: Jorim represents an important link in the unbroken chain of generations that fulfills God's promise that the Messiah would come from David's family.
